profile.summary: Biotech Partners is a nonprofit that helps high school students who are underrepresented in biotechnology. Its Biotech Academy offers classroom instruction and paid summer internships at bioscience companies, and its Bioscience Career Institute combines a year-long biotech job with community college courses. It works with schools including Berkeley High and Oakland Tech.
